integrity: The published exact finite-parameter critical-size formula is acknowledged as prior work; the contribution is the explicit boundary-neighborhood uniqueness proof and two-order singular high-reset-rate expansion. Self-contained analysis and reproducible finite checks; historical priority remains open to independent audit.
limitations: Linear mean-population growth in a one-dimensional perfectly absorbing habitat; deterministic Poisson reset site at distance δ<=1/50 from the boundary, habitat halfwidth π/2, D=g=1. No finite-population extinction prediction, general reset-location theorem, or empirical parameter estimate.
title: Double-logarithmic resetting cost near an absorbing habitat edge
